---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea, enhancement, or UI improvement
title: '[Feature]: '
labels: ['type: feature']
assignees: ''
---

### Problem Statement

A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Example: "I find it repetitive to..." or "The current screen layout makes it difficult to..."

### Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen and how you envision it working.

### Alternatives Considered

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

### Willingness to Contribute

- [ ] I am willing to submit a pull request implementing this feature.
- [ ] I would like assistance or discussion from maintainers before starting implementation.
